notes.title: Unexpected Down Time April 28th
notes.content:
Dear Underlight Community,

Our servers will be offline (web server, game server, all) for an unexpected downtime from April 28th 1:00AM ET until 10:00AM ET.  We experienced power outages throughout the day while the electric company worked on the power lines.  It is unclear if the power will go out again this morning, therefore we are taking precautions to not start up the host with a UPS having zero battery power.  --- In addition there was database corruption experienced for which we will need to restore from backups (prior to the first power loss event April 27th 7:00PM ET).  We hope to be back up and running again later today!

Apologies for the inconvenience!

- KoiTeam

notes.title: Underlight version 3.1.13 to be released on Saturday the 21st
notes.content:
Underlight version 3.1.13 to be released on Saturday the 21st

A huge thank you to everyone who put in the hard effort into this patch within KoiWare and OpenUL!

The release will require downtime between 10:00am - 1:00pm ET. Maintenance will also be included on this time frame, so will be longer than usual.

3.1.13 - Release Notes

**Changes / Fixes**
-OpenUL: New Art: Distress Call: See your local elders to learn more!
-OpenUL: Fix: XP gain issue: Dreamers could reach the fake Orbit 100, past Orbit 99 xp ceiling. This has been fixed and unfortunately was a side effect to a prior fix that was put in place a few years ago.
-OpenUL: Enhancement: Proximity Chat distance constant increased allowing for a slightly large squared distance + Removed proximity restrictions for GMs. Elders can be heard anywhere by anyone within the room, and they can hear any non-whisper say/talk from any distance from any dreamer in a room. Dreamers are still bound to this however, see next line..
-OpenUL: Enhancement: Speech Proximity Alert: When dreamers are outside of the above proximity chat distance requirement to hear (see) chat, if there is talking or emoting going on outside earshot, a message will now alert you that you need to move in closer
-OpenUL: House Activities: XP Loss for demotions are now house binding only ---- If the initiator is no longer of House A, and initiated into House B (or just FrS), and the initiated in House A is demoted, the initiator will no longer be penalize XP loss. If you are still part of House A, you will receive a XP loss penalty as it is relevant. (Disclaimer: There will be no XP restorations for past lost XP)
-OpenUL: Enhancement: Give: Now reports who you gave an item to in chat confirmation message. This helps with confusion of giving to wrong person on accident. Receiver can always see who gave them an item by observing the pop-up box at the time of receiving an item to accept.
-Koi: Redesigned and updated the Credits page giving the much needed acknowledgement for all the hard work! (in-game > Esc > Credits Button)
-Koi: Rename functions: "Trigger Switches" bind renamed to "Activate Portal" and "Action" to "Emote".
-Koi: References to Peace Corps renamed to Protectors of the Radiance.
-Koi: Underlight no longer supports Windows XP: Fixed View-port resolution issues related to this change.
-Koi: Fix: PoR portal from PoR Sanctuary to Initiate Missions. Should be member only now, initiate locked.
-Koi: Fix: Portal in Lower Umbric, South Sewer to Albino Caves. 1st sphere lock re-instated.
-Koi: Fix: Portal in East Valley, Gordizo's Grand Entry to Albino Caves. 1st sphere lock re-instated.
-Koi: New: Added City Market.
-Koi: Enhancement: Pagas's Room: Something is lurking here once again. What could it be?
-Koi: Ruined Realm maze reconfigured

- Koi Team

notes.title: Underlight 3.1.11.2 Hotfix - Releases 1-2-2019
notes.content:
Good evening folks,

Hotfix v3.1.11.2 will be released on the evening of 1-2-2019.  See below for the much needed fixes:

- Koi & OpenUL: Server fix: Game server would crash causing players on the effected game server to drop connection and be presented with the following message: "We're sorry but Underlight has lost its server connection - please check that you are connected to your ISP and try again".  At that point the player would not be able to log back in stating they are already logged in and to wait 15 minutes (ghosted).  There could be more issues like this, but this will certainly reduce the storming and ghosting.
- Koi & OpenUL: Client fix: When using the library mission/quest board (and possibly other scenarios) the client would crash, sometimes ghosting the player.

- Koi Team

notes.title: Underlight 3.1.11.1 Hotfix - Released on 12-29-2018
notes.content:
Hello folks!

Hotfix 3.1.11.1 was rolled out on Saturday the 29th at 9:55am EST.  The following issues have been addressed:

- Koi: Court Yard Training Portal: This portal was determined to be a newly trap as players would log in and never leave the Court Yard area. The portal now re-directs to The Welcome Center. 
- OpenUL: Fix issue with not being able to knight initiates to guardians even though the prime was on-hand in inventory.
- Koi: Fix AoE torn-flags in Thresh to full-flags. Changed GoTE thresh flags back to torn-flags
- Koi: Locate Newly Awakened breaks when more than 10 newlies are online. Issue resolved.
- Koi: Redesigned the login dialog box for more clarity. This includes a Starter Guide. Will be improving in near future, but for now, I think this will help our newly awakened!
- OpenUL: Memory leak fixes for game server. This was a needle in a haystack kind of find! We may not need to reboot anymore! Well done Macobas/Tary!
- Koi: Fixed NewlyAwakened, Locate House Member, and Locate Darkmare reporting players as online even though they are not.
- OpenUL & Koi: Other behind the scene fixes that generally do not effect game play directly.

- JorK/DW

notes.title: A Wonderful First Week on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Dreamers!

Since our release on Steam a week ago, we have received a lot of positive feedback on Underlight, and some not so hot.  On the feedback that was constructive, we took note and added it to our road map.  One of which was completed recently: fixing the logon lockout time after getting disconnected.  This was implemented about 24 hours ago and has reduced the headache levels for all!  The other really big part of the road map is moving forward to a new account system.  We realize that this is the biggest hurdle for new players to get through, and we plan to improve this in the future.

On another note, the surge of new players has been amazing! Our casual players were shocked to see so many new dreamers walk in that the teachers, elders, and lyrans could barely keep up with the demand for assistance!  I can assure you though, they ate it up as they had been waiting for this day to come for sometime!  After all, it is the dreamers that keep the city alive.  There cannot be new content without the dreamers.  Without you, the fabric of the dream would cease to exist.

Lucid dreams!

- KoiWare Team
